# WorldInfo

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/scene/`](../folders/src-scene.md)
> **Source:** [`src/scene/world.h`](../../../src/scene/world.h), [`src/scene/world.cpp`](../../../src/scene/world.cpp)

## Summary

A world's index, seed and template name.

## Description

World registry context variable emplaced by the World constructor and never changed afterwards. index is the world's position in Worlds (global across all world entries of the scene), seed the value passed to WorldRng, template_name the template without the @<entry> suffix of per-entry variable resolution. Read by resetSphereEpisode in logic/agents/sphere_roller.cpp (spawn centre x = index * spawn_spacing).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | `uint32_t` | 0 | world index in the scene, 0-based |
| `seed` | `uint64_t` | 0 | worldSeed(base_seed, index) |
| `template_name` | `std::string` | "" | world template name, '@<n>' suffix dropped |
